description: A showrunner must approve the final publicity campaign for a streaming drama's season premiere, including the teaser edit, talent segment, launch date, broadcast warning, and accessibility deliverables.

shared_context.S1: The season premiere campaign currently contains a 30-second teaser using the song 'Neon Atlas,' a lead-actor interview, and a June 12 launch date.
shared_context.S2: The draft campaign uses the generic music credit 'Original song from the series,' has no flashing-lights warning, and lists captions as optional.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the binding approval for the final publicity package.
shared_context.S4: The production's normal final-clearance meeting includes a review from music, talent publicity, network standards, and accessibility before Mara approves the package.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the signed music license with the publisher this morning and confirmed that 'Neon Atlas' may be used in the teaser for exactly 12 seconds, with the required credit 'Neon Atlas — written by Lila Hart'; he has not yet entered the license terms in the campaign tracker.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the lead actor's agent today that the actor can do only a remote interview on June 20 from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM, and the campaign cannot launch before June 20 because of the actor's publicity hold; the agent's confirmation is still in her email rather than the shared calendar.

PF3.text: Victor checked the network's current standards bulletin this afternoon and confirmed that every paid video containing the show's flashing-light sequence must carry the exact advisory 'Flashing lights warning' at the beginning; he has not attached the bulletin to the campaign approval file.

PF4.text: Sana confirmed with the streaming platform's delivery team this week that the premiere teaser must include open captions and a separate audio-description track; the platform requirement has not yet been added to the delivery checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The teaser must use exactly 12 seconds of 'Neon Atlas.'
The music credit must read exactly 'Neon Atlas — written by Lila Hart.'
The lead segment must be a remote interview scheduled for June 20 from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM.
The campaign must launch on June 20.
The flashing-light advisory must read exactly 'Flashing lights warning.'
The teaser must use open captions and include a separate audio-description track.
The music license terms, talent availability, standards warning, and accessibility deliverables must each have a corresponding production commitment.

content_checks.C2: decisions['music_credit'] == 'Neon Atlas — written by Lila Hart'
content_checks.C4: decisions['lead_segment_time'] in ['June 20, 2:00 PM-3:00 PM', 'June 20, 2:00 PM - 3:00 PM', 'June 20, 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM']
content_checks.C9: decisions['promo_clip_duration_seconds'] == 12 and decisions['music_credit'] == 'Neon Atlas — written by Lila Hart' and any(c['type'] in ['music_license_update', 'tracker_update', 'documentation', 'administrative'] and c['target'] in ['Neon Atlas', 'Jonah'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: decisions['campaign_launch_date'] == 'June 20' and any(c['type'] in ['talent_availability_hold', 'calendar_update', 'documentation', 'administrative'] and c['target'] in ['lead actor', 'Leila'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(c['type'] in ['standards-warning', 'file_attachment', 'documentation', 'administrative'] and c['target'] in ['Victor', 'standards'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C12: any(c['type'] in ['accessibility-delivery', 'checklist_update', 'documentation', 'administrative'] and c['target'] in ['Sana', 'accessibility'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The license changes the teaser music duration from the draft 30 seconds to exactly 12 seconds and changes the credit to the exact wording 'Neon Atlas — written by Lila Hart.'
The agent confirmation changes the lead segment to a remote interview at exactly June 20, 2:00 PM-3:00 PM and moves the campaign launch from June 12 to June 20.
The standards bulletin changes the omitted warning to the exact beginning-of-video advisory 'Flashing lights warning' and requires a standards-warning commitment.
The platform requirement changes captions from optional to open captions and adds a separate audio-description track, requiring an accessibility-delivery commitment.
